name: vscode-kopytko
description: BrightScript & Kopytko language support for Visual Studio Code — syntax, IntelliSense, diagnostics, and Kopytko import resolution.

scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:extension && npm run bundle:server

kopytko.imports.resolveModules.description: Resolve @import annotations from installed Kopytko NPM modules.

kopytko.imports.sourceDir.description: Root source directory for resolving internal @import paths (matches .kopytkorc sourceDir).

kopytko.imports.generatedPaths.markdownDescription:
Glob patterns for `@import` paths that are generated during the build process and do not exist as source files on disk (e.g. by a Kopytko plugin or code-generation tool). Unresolved imports matching these patterns are shown as informational hints instead of warnings, so the developer is aware of the situation without it being flagged as an error.

**Supported wildcards:** `*` matches any characters except `/`; `**` matches any characters including `/`.

**Examples:**
- `/components/generated/**`
- `**/auto-generated/*.brs`

path.description: Glob pattern matching the @import path of the generated file.

functions.description: Function and sub names exported by the generated file.

kopytko.imports.generatedModules.markdownDescription:
Declarations for `@import` paths that are generated during the build process and whose function names should be known to the language server.

Each entry has a `path` glob pattern and a `functions` list. When a file imports a path matching `path`, the listed functions are added to the known function scope — so they are not flagged as undefined — and the import itself is shown as an informational hint rather than an unresolved warning.

Use this when a plugin or code-generation tool creates `.brs` files that are not present as source files on disk but will exist at build time.

**Example:**
```json
[
  {
    "path": "/components/generated/PluginApi.brs",
    "functions": ["PluginInit", "PluginGetData"]
  }
]
```

kopytko.imports.siblingPatterns.markdownDescription:
Groups of file name patterns whose `.brs` files share import scope for the `import/unused` diagnostic check.

Files in the same group are always loaded together by the same XML component, so an `@import` in one file is considered used if any file in the group references one of its exported functions.

**Pattern syntax:** each pattern may contain a single `*` wildcard; files with the same wildcard value in the same directory are considered siblings.

**Example** — Kopytko component/template pairs:
```json
[
  ["*.component.brs", "*.template.brs"],
  ["*.view.brs", "*.template.brs"]
]
```
With this config, if `Foo.component.brs` imports `helperFn` and only `Foo.template.brs` calls it, the import is not flagged as unused.

kopytko.readOnlyPaths.markdownDescription:
Glob patterns for files that the extension should treat as read-only. Acts as a shared fallback — applies to both formatting and linting unless overridden by `kopytko.format.readOnlyPaths` or `kopytko.lint.readOnlyPaths`.

**Supported wildcards:** `*` matches any characters except `/`; `**` matches any characters including `/`.

**Examples:**
```json
[
  "**/node_modules/**",
  "**/generated/**",
  "**/vendor/*.brs"
]
```

kopytko.format.readOnlyPaths.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for files that the formatter should skip. When set, overrides `kopytko.readOnlyPaths` for formatting. When empty, falls back to `kopytko.readOnlyPaths`.

kopytko.lint.readOnlyPaths.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for files that the linter should skip. When set, overrides `kopytko.readOnlyPaths` for linting. When empty, falls back to `kopytko.readOnlyPaths`.

kopytko.lint.rules.type/missing-return-t.description: Warn when a function is missing an 'as Type' return type annotation.

kopytko.lint.rules.type/missing-param-ty.description: Warn when a function parameter is missing an 'as Type' annotation.

enumDescriptions: Keep the catalog casing (e.g. Abs, CreateObject)
First letter uppercase, rest lowercase (e.g. Abs, Createobject)
First word lowercase, subsequent words capitalised (e.g. abs, createObject)
kopytko.casing.builtin.description: Casing applied to BrightScript built-in function names when a completion is inserted.

enumDescriptions: Keep the catalog casing (e.g. for, end sub)
First letter uppercase, rest lowercase (e.g. For, End sub)
Each word capitalised (e.g. For, End Sub)
First word lowercase, subsequent words capitalised (e.g. for, end Sub)
kopytko.casing.keyword.description: Casing applied to BrightScript keywords when a completion is inserted. Acts as fallback for type, literal, and operator casing when those are not set.

kopytko.casing.type.markdownDescription: Casing for BrightScript type names (`boolean`, `integer`, `string`, `void`, …). Falls back to `kopytko.casing.keyword` when not set.

kopytko.casing.literal.markdownDescription: Casing for literal values (`true`, `false`, `invalid`). Falls back to `kopytko.casing.keyword` when not set.

kopytko.casing.logicOperator.markdownDescription: Casing for logic operators (`and`, `or`, `not`). Falls back to `kopytko.casing.keyword` when not set.

kopytko.casing.mathOperator.markdownDescription: Casing for math operators (`mod`). Falls back to `kopytko.casing.keyword` when not set.

enumDescriptions: Keep the catalog casing (e.g. Push, SetUrl)
First letter uppercase, rest lowercase (e.g. Push, Seturl)
First word lowercase, subsequent words capitalised (e.g. push, setUrl)
kopytko.casing.method.description: Casing applied to component method names when a completion is inserted.

enumDescriptions: First word lowercase, subsequent words capitalised
kopytko.casing.userFunction.description: Casing applied to user-defined function/sub names in completions and formatting.

enumDescriptions: First word lowercase, subsequent words capitalised
kopytko.casing.userMethod.description: Casing applied to user-defined associative array method names in completions.

kopytko.casing.exact.markdownDescription:
Per-identifier casing overrides applied after all other casing rules. Keys are identifier names (case-insensitive), values are the exact output string.

**Example:**
```json
{
  "invalid": "Invalid",
  "getglobalaa": "GetGlobalAA"
}
```

kopytko.format.indentSize.description: Number of spaces per indentation level used by the BrightScript formatter.

kopytko.format.useTabs.description: Use tabs instead of spaces for indentation.

kopytko.format.lineEnding.description: Line ending style. 'auto' preserves the document's existing endings.

kopytko.format.insertFinalNewline.description: Ensure the file ends with a newline.

kopytko.format.maxEmptyLines.description: Maximum consecutive blank lines allowed. 0 = no limit.

kopytko.format.emptyLinesBetweenFunction.description: Number of blank lines to enforce between top-level function/sub declarations.

kopytko.format.emptyLinesBetweenMethods.description: Number of blank lines between AA method definitions inside a builder function.

kopytko.format.emptyLinesAtBlockBoundari.description: Blank lines at the start/end of blocks: 'strip' removes them, 'enforce' adds one.

kopytko.format.endKeywordStyle.markdownDescription: Compound end-keyword style: `spaced` = `end if`, `compact` = `endif`. Applies to endif, endfunction, endsub, endwhile, endfor, endtry.

enumDescriptions: Convert all void procedures to use function keyword
Convert all void procedures to use sub keyword (removes 'as Void')
Allow function() as Void — keep both function-with-Void and sub as valid styles
kopytko.format.functionVsSubForVoid.markdownDescription:
Controls function vs sub for void procedures.

```brightscript
' "sub": converts function foo() as Void → sub foo()
' "function": converts sub foo() → function foo() as Void
' "allow-void": preserves both sub foo() and function foo() as Void
```

kopytko.format.spaceBeforeNamedFunctionP.markdownDescription:
Space before `(` in named function/sub definitions.

```brightscript
' true:  function doWork ()
' false: function doWork()
```

kopytko.format.spaceBeforeAnonymousFunct.markdownDescription:
Space before `(` in anonymous function expressions.

```brightscript
' true:  m.handler = function ()
' false: m.handler = function()
```

kopytko.format.spaceBeforeCallParens.markdownDescription:
Space before `(` in function calls.

```brightscript
' true:  doWork ()
' false: doWork()
```

kopytko.format.spaceInsideParens.description: Spaces inside '()' in calls and definitions.

kopytko.format.maxLineLength.markdownDescription: Max line length before the formatter wraps long strings. `0` = no limit.

kopytko.format.wrapLongStrings.markdownDescription:
How to break long string literals.

- `plus`: break with `+` concatenation
- `array-join`: break with `[..., ...].join("")`

kopytko.format.associativeArrayBracketSp.markdownDescription: Spaces inside `{}`: `{ key: value }` (true) vs `{key: value}` (false).

enumDescriptions: Space after comma only: `{ a: 1, b: 2 }`.
Space on both sides: `{ a: 1 , b: 2 }`.
kopytko.format.associativeArrayCommaSpac.markdownDescription: Spaces around commas separating key-value pairs in inline associative arrays `{}`. Only applies to commas on the same line as `{` and `}` — multi-line AAs are not affected.

kopytko.format.trailingComma.description: Trailing comma after the last item in multi-line arrays and associative arrays.

kopytko.format.arrayCommaStyle.markdownDescription:
Comma separators in multi-line arrays. BrightScript allows omitting commas when items are on separate lines.

```brightscript
' "always":
arr = [
  1,
  2,
  3,
]

' "never":
arr = [
  1
  2
  3
]
```

kopytko.format.associativeArraySingleLin.description: Max number of keys before forcing an AA to multi-line. 0 = no limit.

kopytko.format.spaceAroundOperators.description: Spaces around binary operators (+, -, *, /, <>, and, or, mod).

kopytko.format.commentStyle.markdownDescription: Normalize comment markers: `'` or `rem`, or preserve existing.

kopytko.format.spaceAfterCommentMarker.markdownDescription: Enforce space after `'` or `rem`: `' comment` vs `'comment`.

kopytko.format.commentWidth.description: Max comment line length. 0 = no limit.

kopytko.format.sortImports.description: Sort @import statements alphabetically (module name first, then path).

kopytko.format.emptyLineAfterImports.description: Insert blank line after the last @import line, before code starts.

kopytko.format.emptyLineAfterFunctionOpe.description: Insert empty line after function/sub opening line.

kopytko.format.emptyLineBeforeFunctionCl.description: Insert empty line before end function/sub.

enumDescriptions: Always add an empty line before return
Add an empty line only when return is NOT the sole statement in a block
Do not enforce empty lines before return
kopytko.format.emptyLineBeforeReturn.markdownDescription: Empty line before `return` statements. `not-alone` skips the empty line when `return` is the only statement in its block (e.g. a guard clause like `if x then return`).

kopytko.format.emptyLineBeforeComment.description: Enforce empty line before stand-alone comment blocks.

kopytko.format.parenthesisIfCase.description: Wrap if-condition in parentheses: 'always' adds them, 'never' removes them.

kopytko.format.forLoopSpacing.description: Enforce spaces around 'to' and 'step' in for loops.

kopytko.format.printStatement.description: Flag or remove print debug statements.

kopytko.format.lineCommentPosition.description: Move trailing comments: 'above' puts them on the line above.

kopytko.format.stringConcatStyle.markdownDescription:
Normalize string concatenation style.

```brightscript
' "plus":
result = "hello" + " " + "world"

' "array-join":
result = ["hello", " ", "world"].join("")
```

kopytko.format.observeFieldStyle.markdownDescription:
Enforce `observeFieldScoped` over `observeField`. Using non-scoped `observeField` can cause memory leaks.

```brightscript
' "always-scoped": converts
observeField → observeFieldScoped

' "warn": leaves as-is (diagnostic warns)
```

kopytko.format.mPrefixStyle.markdownDescription:
Normalize `m`-prefix field access style.

```brightscript
' "dot":
m.fieldName
m.top.visible

' "bracket":
m["fieldName"]
m.top["visible"]
```

kopytko.format.alignAssignments.markdownDescription:
Align `=` signs in consecutive assignment lines.

```brightscript
' true:
name    = "app"
version = "1.0"
count   = 42

' false:
name = "app"
version = "1.0"
count = 42
```

kopytko.format.fieldAccessConsistency.markdownDescription:
Field access consistency on nodes.

```brightscript
' "dot": prefers dot notation
m.top.visible = true
value = m.top.id

' "method": prefers getField/setField
m.top.setField("visible", true)
value = m.top.getField("id")
```

kopytko.deviceDiscovery.enabled.description: Enable automatic Roku device discovery via SSDP.

kopytko.deviceDiscovery.scanTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for active SSDP device scans.

kopytko.deviceDiscovery.showNotification.description: Show notification messages when devices come online or go offline.

host.description: IP address of the Roku device. Auto-filled from the active device in the Roku Devices panel if omitted.

password.description: Developer password. Auto-filled from the active device's stored credentials if omitted.

rootDir.description: Root directory of the BrightScript project (where .kopytkorc lives).

env.description: Kopytko environment to build (matches .kopytkorc environments key). Auto-filled from the active device's environment selection if omitted.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause execution at the first line of main on launch.

startCommand.description: Command to build and deploy the project (default: 'npx kopytko start'). Must accept env as a positional argument and ROKU_IP, ROKU_DEV_PASSWORD, ENV as environment variables.

configurationSnippets.label: BrightScript: Launch on Roku
configurationSnippets.description: Package and deploy the current project to a Roku device. Host, password, and env are auto-filled from the active device if omitted.
